newsitem.title: UK: Mexico, Sri Lanka feature on sugar freight market.
newsitem.headline: Mexico, Sri Lanka feature on sugar freight market.

text.p: Business slackened off on London's sugar freight market on Thursday but Mexico was once again prominent as a quoted origin and Sri Lanka as a destination, shipbrokers said.

Gill & Duffus was said to have fixed 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Dunkirk or Calais to Tunisia for mid-May and was open for 14,000 tonnes from the Continent to Pakistan for prompt shipment dates.
Shipbrokers said E D & F Man fixed 13/14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from east coast Mexico to Colombo for April 20/28.
Genoc quoted for a prompt 12,500/14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from east coast Mexico to the Mediterranean or Black Sea.
